eligibility.quote:
Looks like something changed into yaml library.
Previously roslaunch provide `degrees` tag, that simply converts value to radians.

failed_conditions.quote: Repair incompatibilities introduced with 5.1. The default Loader was changed, but several methods like add_constructor still used the old default

loudness.quote:
/opt/ros/melodic/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/roslaunch/loader.py:412: YAMLLoadWarning: calling yaml.load() without Loader=... is deprecated, as the default Loader is unsafe. Please read https://msg.pyyaml.org/load for full details.
  data = yaml.load(text)
RLException: error loading <rosparam> tag: 

could not determine a constructor for the tag '!degrees'

resolution.quote: PR #1688 'Switch to yaml.safe_load(_all) to prevent YAMLLoadWarning' merged 2019-04-23T16:20:13Z as 29053c4832229efa7160fb944c05e3bc82e11540; diff read this session: loader.py '-                data = yaml.load(text)' -> '+                data = yaml.safe_load(text)' and rosparam adds '+yaml.SafeLoader.add_constructor(u'!degrees', construct_angle_degrees)'; working compositions reported are workarounds: "I can confirm that downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 works"

notes: Verified this session: mavros #1210 body (RLException log verbatim with loader.py:412, Mavros 0.29.2 / ROS Melodic / PX4, link to PX4 issue 11662); maintainer vooon's two comments ('Looks like something changed into yaml library...' and 'Well, it looks like that roslaunch should be updated to handle pyyaml changes.' — the latter supports the spec's choice of the PyYAML<->ros_comm composition); at ros_comm 1.14.3 I read loader.py line 412 '                data = yaml.load(text)' and rosparam/__init__.py line 635 'yaml.add_constructor(u'!degrees', construct_angle_degrees)' exactly as claimed; PyYAML 3.13 lib/yaml/__init__.py declares 'def load(stream, Loader=Loader):' (L64) and 'def add_constructor(tag, constructor, Loader=Loader):' (L241); PyYAML 5.1 declares 'def load(stream, Loader=None):' (L103) with 'load_warning('load')' / 'Loader = FullLoader' (L109-110); 5.2 CHANGES read verbatim including both entries 'https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/pull/279 -- A more flexible fix for custom tag constructors' and 'https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/pull/287 -- Change default loader for yaml.add_constructor'; PX4 11662 body and comments read: 'I solved the issue by downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 manually with "pip uninstall PyYAML" and "pip install PyYAML==3.13"' and 'I can confirm that downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 works'; ros_comm #1686 body read: 'Good to note is that I have PyYAML version 5.1 installed in my user directory through pip, this won't happen when using pyyaml from the Ubuntu repositories, si[nce that's currently still version 3.12]'. Eligibility step 6 holds: the failure depends on the consumer's assumption that a constructor registered through the default add_constructor is seen by the default load — declarations that changed at PyYAML 5.1; the resolution is a ros_comm code change, not build-only (pinning 3.13 is a workaround that reverts the provider change). Class element_retyped fits (both elements still present, their declarations changed); the YAMLLoadWarning is correctly treated as a second symptom of the same condition, and api:yaml.load_all (rosparam load_str) is correctly not a separate documented condition since the reporter's log exercises only yaml.load. Loudness loud_documented/activate is right: roslaunch aborts with a launch error, explicitly listed in the loudness taxonomy. Resolution recommended is right: no linked thread shows ros_comm at 29053c48 running with PyYAML 5.1.
